name: Sotogahama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sotogahama town emblem in blue, green and light blue: a stylised wave and mountain in blue and green with light blue lines.
history: Municipal flag of Sotogahama, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.
